edge_rule.value: stable, consistent for every traveler, non-damaging, no navigation hints

weather_driver.value: local long-term climate is imposed at the fixed location
weather_driver.rationale: REQ-2 offers this as the default abstraction before long simulation.

surface_water_outflow.value: output-only if enabled; no material, organism, seed, or information return flux
surface_water_outflow.rationale: REQ-2 permits output-only drainage while forbidding hidden external supply.

groundwater_outflow.value: output-only if enabled; no hidden recharge from outside
groundwater_outflow.rationale: REQ-2 requires a closed or explicitly one-way hydrologic boundary.

external_nonliving_material.value: none except declared weather and energy inputs

terrain.slope.required_content: spatial slope distribution and its effect on movement and drainage

terrain.depressions.required_content: location, depth, catchment, and seasonal water retention of low areas

terrain.flood_zones.required_content: flood extent by weather condition and expected frequency

terrain.habitable_land.required_content: land viable for shelter and residence under seasonal conditions

terrain.cultivable_land.required_content: land viable for cultivation before land improvements

freshwater.seasonal_volume.required_content: stored and accessible water volume by season

freshwater.quality.required_content: baseline quality and observable or hidden hazards

freshwater.access_difficulty.required_content: distance, terrain cost, container needs, and assisted access

freshwater.contamination_paths.required_content: transport, dilution, persistence, and exposure pathways

plants.edible_parts.required_content: species and parts edible directly or after processing

plants.maturity_season.required_content: harvest windows, overlap, and seasonal gaps

plants.toxicity.required_content: toxic species, mimic risks, affected parts, and processing limits

plants.harvest_difficulty.required_content: recognition, reach, tool, labor, and handling costs

plants.regeneration.required_content: growth rate and damage thresholds by harvested part and condition

plants.reproduction.required_content: seed, vegetative, or other reproduction and establishment constraints

animals.habitat.required_content: species ranges, cover, water, and seasonal movement

animals.food_sources.required_content: forage or prey dependencies and competition with people

animals.reproduction.required_content: breeding, juvenile survival, and recovery conditions

animals.capture_difficulty.required_content: detection, approach, traps or weapons, handling, and injury risk

animals.harvest_response.required_content: population response to capture, displacement, and habitat pressure

materials.stone.required_content: distribution, form, quantity, and suitability by use

materials.wood.required_content: source species, form, quantity, regrowth, and collection cost

materials.fiber.required_content: source plants or animals, processing, quantity, and durability

materials.clay.required_content: distribution, workability, firing suitability, and extraction cost

materials.processing_conditions.required_content: required tools, fuel, time, skill, and site conditions

land.fertility.required_content: baseline nutrient and cultivation suitability by land unit

land.clearing_cost.required_content: labor, tools, fire, disposal, and injury cost

land.continuous_use_change.required_content: yield, nutrients, erosion, salinity, and recovery under repeated use
